name: Titan C-UAS RF sensor (BlueHalo / AeroVironment)
description: Self-contained RF detection and direction-finding unit, up to 3 km horizontal across five bands from 433 MHz to 5.8 GHz. NOT receive-only: the same 20 lb unit jams to 1.5 km, which belongs in a separate effector record. US Army fielded.

detectRangeM.condition: more than 3000 m horizontal radius, no target class stated

classifyRangeM.condition: protocol identification range — BlueHalo: Titan 'classifies and mitigates multiple threats across five RF bands' and provides 'automated identification and mitigation of threats for all major commercial and hobbyist control protocols and frequency bands'. Classification is inherent to the detect event, so it is set equal to detect range. INFERRED.
classifyRangeM.source: BlueHalo Titan brochure; BlueHalo/PRNewswire Army contract release
classifyRangeM.note: Inventory records 3000 m at INFERRED REPRESENTATIVE; the seed leaves the field null

sectorDeg.condition: azimuth coverage — NOT PUBLISHED. 360 is inferred from the datasheet quoting a bare 'horizontal' detection range with no sector limit, from Titan being described as 'autonomous, self-contained', and from the unit being sold as a single-box solution rather than as faces. If a user needs a sectored build they must override this.

rangeAccuracyM.note: A single-site RF direction finder measures bearing, not range; not established by the public record.

azimuthAccuracyDeg.condition: 1° azimuth tracking of non-precision sUAS platforms
azimuthAccuracyDeg.source: BlueHalo C-UAS RF product page (Titan SV LOB): '1° Azimuth and Elevation tracking of non-precision sUAS platforms', quoted from the search index; the page now redirects to avinc.com

elevationAccuracyDeg.condition: 1° elevation tracking of non-precision sUAS platforms
elevationAccuracyDeg.source: BlueHalo C-UAS RF product page (Titan SV LOB): '1° Azimuth and Elevation tracking of non-precision sUAS platforms', quoted from the search index; the page now redirects to avinc.com

receiverSensitivityDbm.note: Planning factor, 2.4 GHz band, channel-integrated: kTB for a 10 MHz OcuSync-class channel (-104 dBm) plus a 12 dB receiver noise figure (Narda SignalShark C-UAS application note) gives -92 dBm, recorded as -90 dBm. The AV Titan datasheet 250501 gives the bands (2.4 / 5.8 GHz and Wi-Fi on the SF unit; 433 / 868 / 915 MHz, 1.2 GHz and GNSS on the EF unit) and a >3 km detection radius but no sensitivity.

geolocationMinNodes.note: The Titan datasheet (AV 250501) states no direction-finding method and no multi-node geolocation; the 1° azimuth and elevation tracking belongs to the Titan SV LOB variant, which is bearing only. Not established by the public record.

rfBands.value: 2.4 and 5.8 GHz plus Wi-Fi (SF unit); 433, 868 and 915 MHz and 1.2 GHz (EF unit)
